1	"""Full-scale binary profiling — prove the cells are MAXIMAL, not just correct.
2	
3	`verify_all` proves the 99 compositions *compile* and are *structurally* maximal
4	(every cell at its max feasible fusion tier).  This module goes one level deeper:
5	it inspects the **actual emitted machine code** to prove the binaries do what we
6	want *maximally* — the compute-bound paths use the silicon's tensor cores, the
7	async-copy engines, and don't spill registers — and that the optimizer math
8	*actually optimizes* when executed.
9	
10	It needs no live GPU/TPU.  Everything here is host-side binary inspection of the
11	real compiled artifacts plus CPU execution of the fused programs:
12	
13	  TIER A — sm_90 GEMM instruction maximality (nvcc + ptxas + cuobjdump SASS):
14	    the model TUs (decoder/vit/mamba) and supergrok2 must emit Hopper WGMMA
15	    tensor-core MMA + TMA async-bulk copies via the CUTLASS Sm90 collectives,
16	    with the wgmma pipeline NOT serialized (ptxas C7509) and ZERO register
17	    spills. This is where "maximal" is decided — GEMMs are compute-bound.
18	
19	  TIER B — sm_90 resource health (ptxas -v): real registers / shared-memory /
20	    spill bytes for a sample of fused cells + the optimizer-step kernels,
21	    cross-checked against the megakernel solver's budget. Spills => not maximal.
22	
23	  TIER C — gfx942 (MI300X) REAL emitted-ISA maximality (clang AMDGPU +
24	    llvm-objdump + llvm-readobj): the attention/decoder/vit/mamba device code
25	    must emit actual ``v_mfma`` CDNA3 matrix-core instructions (disassembled
26	    from the object, not grepped from source) + DPP cross-lane ops, within the
27	    VGPR budget read from the real AMDGPU kernel descriptor.
28	
29	  TIER D — functional correctness (CPU execution): run the real fused
30	    (model, optimizer) program on CPU via the Pallas path and confirm the
31	    optimizer ACTUALLY reduces a loss and moves parameters finitely — the
32	    binaries do what we want, *period*.
33	
34	  TIER E — tpu_v6e (Trillium) HLO maximality (jax compile + run): each fused
35	    cell's real program must compile to optimized HLO containing ``dot_general``
36	    MXU matmuls + XLA fusion, execute on the host backend with finite output,
37	    and the v6e binding must use the 256-wide MXU tile.
38	
39	All three target archs thus get the SAME emitted-code standard: sm_90 SASS
40	(A/B), gfx942 ISA (C), tpu_v6e HLO (E). Live wall-clock / occupancy / real MXU
41	emission are the silicon-only residual for every arch.
42	
43	Each tier prints PASS/FAIL/SKIP and the measured numbers; a final report gives
44	the maximality verdict, the real-vs-estimate table, and what remains silicon-
45	gated (true latency/occupancy require the clock).
46	
47	Run:
48	    PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m grokking_optimizers.profile_maximal              # all
49	    PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m grokking_optimizers.profile_maximal --tier A     # one
50	    PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m grokking_optimizers.profile_maximal --quick      # D only
51	"""

75	class Probe:
76	    tier: str
77	    name: str
78	    status: str
79	    detail: str = ""

83	class Report:
84	    def __init__(self) -> None:
85	        self.probes: List[Probe] = []
86	        self.silicon: List[str] = []
87	        self.design: List[str] = []
88	        self.table: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []  # (label, measured) rows

90	    def add(self, p: Probe) -> Probe:
91	        self.probes.append(p)
92	        glyph = {"PASS": "PASS ", "FAIL": "FAIL ", "SKIP-silicon": "SKIP "}[p.status]
93	        tail = f"  ({p.seconds:.0f}s)" if p.seconds >= 1 else ""
94	        line = f"  {glyph} [{p.tier}] {p.name}{tail}"
95	        if p.detail:
96	            line += f"\n         {p.detail}"
97	        sys.stdout.write(line + "\n")
98	        sys.stdout.flush()
99	        return p

102	        return sum(1 for p in self.probes if p.status == status)

111	        import torch

126	_MAX_NVCC = [
127	    "-c", "-std=c++17", "-O3", "--use_fast_math", "-DNDEBUG",
128	    "-DWITH_CUDA", "-DWITH_CUTLASS",
129	    "-gencode", "arch=compute_90a,code=sm_90a",

135	class SassProfile:
136	    rc: int
137	    regs_max: int
138	    smem_max: int
139	    spill_bytes: int
140	    c7509: int           # wgmma-serialization warnings
141	    wgmma: int

143	    mbarrier: int
144	    mufu: int
145	    ffma: int

149	def _nvcc_profile(tu: Path, timeout: int = 900) -> SassProfile:
150	    """Compile a sm_90 TU with the maximal flags + ptxas -v, then SASS-audit."""
151	    obj = Path(tempfile.mktemp(suffix=".o"))
152	    cmd = ["nvcc", *_MAX_NVCC, *_torch_incs(), "-Xptxas", "-v",
153	           str(tu), "-o", str(obj)]
154	    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=str(REPO_ROOT), capture_output=True,
155	                          text=True, timeout=timeout)
156	    log = (proc.stdout or "") + (proc.stderr or "")
157	    regs = [int(m) for m in re.findall(r"Used (\d+) registers", log)]
158	    smem = [int(m) for m in re.findall(r"(\d+) bytes smem", log)]
159	    spills = [int(m) for m in re.findall(r"(\d+) bytes spill stores", log)]
160	    c7509 = len(re.findall(r"C7509", log))
161	    wgmma = tma = mbar = mufu = ffma = 0
162	    if proc.returncode == 0 and obj.exists():
163	        sass = subprocess.run(["cuobjdump", "-sass", str(obj)],
164	                              capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
165	        wgmma = len(re.findall(r"\b[HUW]?GMMA\b", sass))
166	        tma = len(re.findall(r"UTMALDG|UBLKCP|cp\.async\.bulk", sass))
167	        mbar = len(re.findall(r"MBARRIER|ELECT|ARRIVES", sass))
168	        mufu = len(re.findall(r"MUFU", sass))
169	        ffma = len(re.findall(r"\bFFMA\b", sass))
170	        obj.unlink(missing_ok=True)
171	    return SassProfile(
172	        proc.returncode, max(regs, default=0), max(smem, default=0),
173	        max(spills, default=0), c7509, wgmma, tma, mbar, mufu, ffma, log)

192	def tier_a_gemm(rep: Report) -> None:
193	    sys.stdout.write("\n[TIER A] sm_90 GEMM instruction maximality "
194	                     "(WGMMA + TMA, no wgmma-serialization, no spills)\n")

213	        detail = (f"WGMMA={pr.wgmma} TMA={pr.tma} mbarrier={pr.mbarrier} "
214	                  f"MUFU={pr.mufu} C7509={pr.c7509} spills={pr.spill_bytes}B")

217	            detail += "  ← NO tensor-core MMA (not maximal!)"
218	        elif pr.c7509 > 0:
219	            detail += "  ← wgmma SERIALIZED (not maximal!)"

299	    v_mfma: int

309	def _gfx942_isa(src: Path) -> IsaProfile:
310	    """Emit a real gfx942 ELF object, disassemble for v_mfma/DPP, and read the
311	    AMDGPU kernel descriptors for VGPR/SGPR/LDS — the MI300X SASS-equivalent."""
312	    obj = Path(tempfile.mktemp(suffix=".o"))
313	    proc = subprocess.run(
314	        ["bash", "scripts/amdgcn_check.sh", "--emit-obj", str(src), str(obj)],
315	        cwd=str(REPO_ROOT), capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=180)
316	    if proc.returncode != 0 or not obj.exists():
317	        err = next((ln for ln in (proc.stdout + proc.stderr).splitlines()

321	                         capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
322	    v_mfma = len(re.findall(r"\bv_mfma", dis))
323	    dpp = len(re.findall(r"v_\w+_dpp|ds_bpermute|ds_swizzle|ds_permute", dis))
324	    lds_ops = len(re.findall(r"\bds_(read|write)", dis))
